unlock_condition: v3.8 registers the FTS/vector/hybrid retrieval evidence contract; public claims require non-fixture accepted artifacts across all claimed modes.

tasks.title: Knowledge update source-hit recall
tasks.prompt: Run the knowledge-update query across fts, vector, and hybrid modes. Report expected source ids, retrieved source ids, recall_at_1, recall_at_5, recall_at_10, latency, fallback, and token/cost estimate.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must report per-mode source-hit recall without turning fixture evidence into a public retrieval claim.
required_facts: Recall metrics are reported per mode.
forbidden_claims: Fixture rows prove public retrieval recall.
Source-hit recall proves final answer correctness.
Hybrid latency is ready when hybrid fell back to FTS.

tasks.title: Temporal source-hit recall
tasks.prompt: Run the temporal query across fts, vector, and hybrid modes. Keep current/history/source-hit evidence separate and report fallback status for every mode.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must preserve temporal scope and per-mode fallback evidence.
required_facts: Expected source ids are compared to retrieved source ids.
Fallback status is visible per mode.
forbidden_claims: Temporal product correctness is inferred from source-hit recall alone.
A fallback row is counted as true hybrid evidence.

tasks.title: Multi-session release boundary recall
tasks.prompt: Run the multi-session release-boundary query across fts, vector, and hybrid modes. Report whether the retrieved sources support only bounded public claims.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must keep release claim boundaries and retrieval recall readiness separate.
required_facts: Recall readiness is separated from artifact acceptance.
Embedding baseline and candidates remain governed metadata.
forbidden_claims: Accepted artifacts automatically make public claims ready.
The fixture changes the default embedding baseline.
Token/cost estimate is treated as real billing evidence.
